summary.text: BE YOUR BEST AS is a private limited company registered in Oslo, founded 2015-04-01. BE YOUR BEST AS is a company engaged in software development. Its statutory purpose is to develop and sell software for mental training of elite athletes. It was previously named BE YOUR BEST GLOBAL AS until 2021-10-26. Its main industry code is 62.100: computer programming activities. The register shows 8 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 13 162 112 NOK and the annual result was -5 638 950 NOK; operating income was down from 13 197 924 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 186 722 NOK in 2024 to -5 638 950 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 32 230 324 NOK in 2024 to 28 973 306 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Andreas Hajanirina Fiderana Olsen (daglig leder) and Odd Petter Skarheim (styrets leder). The registered employee count went from 9 on 2026-02-13 to 8 on 2026-09-15. Recent changes in the register: email set to contact@beyourbest.com on 2026-06-22.
